question: With the same native schemas, complete Skill/reference corpus and P26 limits, does making describe_operation optional for already advertised native tools permit target-connected staging before interruption?
task_source: P26 FREEZE.json tasks.HE41; exact public requirement and original stub bundle only
task_selection: Developmental, chosen after P26 because it reached reference construction; not held-out or independent task generalization

slots.condition: Same N plus one descriptor-policy override

intervention_exact_developer_addendum: For native MCP tools, use the advertised input schema for argument shape. The Skill instruction requiring describe_operation before mutation is optional in this condition: call describe_operation only when the advertised schema is insufficient or a concrete tool error needs clarification. Keep describe_construction and all remaining Skill rules unchanged, including real revision IDs, discovery needed to identify the target, transaction checking before commit, authority rules, and independent compilation and tests.
unchanged: HE41 public task and original source bytes
all twenty P25 native tools and schemas
full official Skill and all reference documents in initial input
no task solution example or target-specific recipe
P22/P23 Linux isolation and independent evaluator
120000 observed total tokens, 80 dispatched tools, 480 seconds, 20-second interrupt grace
primary: Before the first frozen resource interruption, an actual changed bench.solve staged body is confirmed by a trusted read-only inspect_body observation in the same live transaction. No credit for detached nodes or ok:true alone.
observer: If later implemented, add the same non-model-visible read-only body-hash observer to both arms after mutation, before process closure. Freeze/test it first; never feed hidden evaluator or reference content to the model. It may not repair, commit or generate next actions.
secondary: descriptor calls and enclosing usage intervals before first construction/attachment
actual input/cached/output/reasoning-output totals without cache subtraction
successful commit with changed fresh authoritative target
parameter errors and missing semantic-precondition failures
fidelity: Record delivery and actual describe_operation calls. If the optional policy does not change descriptor behavior, mark no behavioral uptake rather than evidence that descriptor content is useless.
falsifier: If C1 reduces descriptor calls but still does not reach a changed connected target before interruption, this wave does not support the proposed stage-progress mechanism. If both reach it, no differentiating result. Attachment without compile/behavior closure is not utility.
interpretation_limit: Two fresh developmental observations cannot establish a general effect or identify P26 root cause. The override adds a small amount of instruction text; report its bytes, do not compensate by removing documents or increasing budget.
before_any_future_generation: Separate user authorization; implement only the shared read-only observer and bounded instruction toggle; mechanically validate the two inputs, isolation and terminal accounting; commit/push a new real execution freeze with exact SDK/controller/tool/docs/evaluator/prompt bytes and order. Do not use this design JSON as an execution-ready freeze.
stop: Each slot once, no retry/replacement/third slot. Ordinary task failure retained; common infrastructure defect stops the remaining wave. No automatic launch from P27.
